name: com.unityutilities.flexiblegridlayout
description:
A smarter grid for Unity UI. Like the built-in Grid Layout Group, but cells can span multiple columns and rows, flow around larger elements with CSS-style auto-placement (dense packing), snap to fixed positions, and align the whole block inside its container.

Add via Add Component > Layout > Flexible Grid Layout Group, then add Flexible Grid Cell to any child to give it a span or a fixed slot.
